notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
